answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each clearing identity to a unique posted margin account whose collateral is escrowed and slashable, so forged identities cannot share one oasis of capital. Counterparties cross-validate exposure attestations through a nebula of independent validators, and each agent signs a deterministic sonnet-like hash commitment over its margin state. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
